sections.text_helper: Section 12.5.12 "SBS ECC NMI mask register (SBS_ECCNMIR)" in chapter 12 (System configuration, boot, and security (SBS)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 369.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x14C
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Reset: system reset
Register security: This register is only accessible through a privilege transaction.
This register sets up the expected behavior on NMI regarding double ECC errors from the
flash memory.
Bits 31:1 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 0 ECCNMI_MASK_EN: NMI behavior setup when a double ECC error occurs on FLASH data
part
0: NMI generated if a double ECC error in the FLASH data part
1: NMI not generated if a double ECC error in the FLASH data part
